---
name: Become an OpenDP Contributor
---

Thank you for your interest in becoming an OpenDP Contributor.
We don't require any additional information right now:
We will will add you to the group, and then you'll be able to sign the
[individual](https://github.com/opendp/clabot-config/actions/workflows/sign-individual.yml)
or [company](https://github.com/opendp/clabot-config/actions/workflows/sign-company.yml)
CLA.
